newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp completes TPC tender offer.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp completes TPC tender offer.

text.p: PacifiCorp unit PacifiCorp Holdings Inc said Tuesday it has completed its cash tender offer for TPC Corp.
TPC is a natural gas gathering, processing, storage and marketing company based in Houston, Texas. The acquisition is part of PacifiCorp's strategy to become a full service energy provider.
At the expiration of the tender offer at midnight on April 14, more than 90 percent of TPC's outstanding shares had been tendered and accepted for payment.
On March 12 PacifiCorp began its tender for TPC at $13.41 per common share. The acquisition of TPC was subject to the tender of a majority of TPC's outstanding shares.
PacifiCorp expects to complete the acquisition of 100 percent of the common stock of TPC later on Tuesday.
